children: US wood pellet grill maker's Q3 revenue fell 40% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted loss per share for Q3 missed analyst expectations
Company says lower grill sales and channel actions drove revenue decline
Traeger expects FY26 revenue between $440 mln and $460 mln, narrowing prior range
Company reiterates FY26 gross margin guidance of 40.0% to 41.0%
Traeger sees FY26 adjusted EBITDA between $59 mln and $65 mln, narrowing prior range
RETAILER PURCHASES AND CHANNEL ACTIONS - Co said lower grill sales were due to elevated retailer purchases last year and product/channel actions under Project Gravity
SEASONAL AND CHANNEL EFFECTS - Co said lower consumables revenue was mainly due to timing of wood pellet orders and changes in retail channel dynamics
MARGIN PRESSURE - Co said lower gross margin was due to timing of trade spend, deleverage of fixed warehousing costs, and margin pressure in MEATER business
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 6 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the appliances, tools & housewares peer group is "hold"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Traeger, Inc. is $64.50, about 26.7% above its November 3 closing price of $50.91
